text:
Jordan (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on hiring bands, lateral moves, and team allocation — trying to answer the questions we ran out of time for.
Aisha (People Ops): Short Q — are the new hiring bands effective immediately? How will this affect offers already in flight?
Jordan (CEO): Bands roll out next week. Offers already in flight will be honored at the current band plus a one-time adjustment where applicable. People Ops will email affected candidates tomorrow.
Liam (Hiring): Will the band change affect approvals for internal transfers/promotions? I have two IC->M promos in process.
Aisha (People Ops): Internal transfers will be evaluated under the new bands, but there is a 30-day grace period for approvals so current workflows don't get blocked.
Raja (Head Eng): Reorg question — are we still centralizing platform responsibilities into eng-infra, or are we keeping more autonomy in product infra squads? Timeline?
Maya (VP Product): We decided to keep product-facing infra squads but centralize shared platform ops into Eng Infra. Target completion: end of Q2.
Sofia (Staff Eng): For headcount: can managers request rebalancing of existing roles rather than new hires? What criteria will ops use?
Jordan (CEO): Yes — managers can request rebalances. Ops will prioritize changes that unblock shipped commitments or reduce critical dependencies. We'll look at impact, ramp time, and product milestones.
Kai (Manager): Is there a public view of the headcount plan per pod? Would help when discussing rebalances with my skip.
Aisha (People Ops): Yes — the living headcount doc is in #all-hands-docs. Link (internal): <https://redwood.company/handbook/headcount-q2>. We'll keep it updated after each budget sync.
Liam (Hiring): Will we loosen the interview bar to fill roles faster given the timeline?
Raja (Head Eng): No — the bar stands. We can approve short-term contractor support for critical gaps and accelerate interview cycles, but quality threshold remains.
Kai (Manager): One more — can we get clarity on L4 vs L5 expectations? Some inconsistency in calibrations.
Sofia (Staff Eng): We'll run a calibration session next Thursday 10:00am PT and publish notes. Invites going out in ~30m.
Aisha (People Ops): :thumbsup: I'll publish an FAQ and a TL;DR of the new bands and transfer rules on the handbook page after the calibration.
Jordan (CEO): Final: if you have impacted candidates or transfers, please ping Aisha or Liam directly — we'll triage exceptions. Appreciate the questions — leaving the thread open for anything we missed.
Kai (Manager): Thanks, this helps a lot.
Liam (Hiring): Thanks — will follow up with the two candidates I mentioned.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Calibration: L4/L5 scope" — Thu 10:00am PT.
Aisha (People Ops): Closing note: we'll host an optional office hours on Friday 1pm PT for managers to walk through rebalancing requests.
Jordan (CEO): Thanks everyone :rocket:
